scientific_integrity: The boundedness, compactness and p>1 claims rely on acknowledged prior factorable-matrix theory; new endpoint and finite-section statements have a separate explicit analytic proof. Supplementary numerical checks cannot establish infinite-dimensional results. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: One real power-log family on the Dirichlet Hilbert space; asymptotic nuclear growth only up to multiplicative constants; no general arbitrary-weight characterization or exact singular-value asymptotic coefficients.
title: Logarithmic nuclearity threshold for critical Dirichlet Rhaly operators
